title: The Exorcist – Martyrs Trailer Out
excerpt: Official trailer for The Exorcist – Martyrs — premieres Mar 12.
body:
• The trailer for The Exorcist – Martyrs dropped October 09, 2026.
  • Releasing Mar 12.
  • Darkness must be hunted. Mike Flanagan’s The Exorcist: Martyrs is only in theaters March 12.

The makers of The Exorcist – Martyrs have released the official trailer, unveiled October 09, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to theaters.
